ja: 原因は彼が見つけたバグだと思う。
en: I think it's the bug he found.
alternatives: I think the bug he found is the cause.
I think the bug he found caused it.
point: I think の中に the bug he found が入る

ja: 業者が抜けて以来、遅れてます。
en: We've slipped since the vendor left.
alternatives: We've fallen behind since the vendor left.
We've been behind since the vendor dropped out.
point: since の後ろは過去形、主節は現在完了

ja: 私が伝えてたら、こうならなかった。
en: If I'd flagged it, this wouldn't have happened.
alternatives: Had I flagged it, this wouldn't have happened.
If I'd reported it, this wouldn't have happened.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had + 過去分詞

ja: 私、問題があります。
en: I have a problem.
alternatives: I've got a problem.
I have an issue.
point: 数えられる名詞の単数には a。problem は子音

ja: 私たちは不足分を補える。
en: We can make up the shortfall.
alternatives: We can cover the shortfall.
We're able to make up the deficit.
point: make up the shortfall は不足分を埋め合わせる。

ja: 私があなたなら、上司に話します。
en: If I were you, I'd tell your boss.
alternatives: If I were you, I'd talk to your boss.
I'd tell your boss, if I were you.
point: If I were you は仮定法の定番

ja: スライドを作成中です。
en: I'm making the slides.
alternatives: I'm working on the slides.
I'm preparing the slides.
point: 「〜中」は am + -ing。slide は複数形で

ja: 私は彼に報告を頼んだ。
en: I asked him to report.
alternatives: I asked him for a report.
I requested that he report.
point: ask 人 to do で依頼した内容を伝える。

ja: 予算案は棚上げだと彼女に言われた。
en: She said the budget was shelved.
alternatives: She told me the budget had been shelved.
She said the budget was put on ice.
point: 「棚上げ」は shelve。said の後ろは過去形にそろえる

ja: 君はいつ始める？
en: When do you start?
alternatives: When are you starting?
When will you begin?
point: when で作業を始める時を尋ねる。

ja: 確認前に彼は引き下がってた。
en: He'd backed down before the review.
alternatives: He'd withdrawn his claim before the review.
He'd dropped his objection before the review.
point: back down は主張を引っ込める。

ja: 保留中の資金が足かせです。
en: Funding on hold is a bottleneck.
alternatives: The funding on hold is delaying us.
The pending funding is holding us back.
point: on hold は保留中、bottleneck は進行の妨げ。

ja: 不具合は修正されました。
en: The bug was fixed.
alternatives: The bug got fixed.
The issue was fixed.
The bug has been fixed.
point: 受け身は was + 過去分詞。fix は fixed

ja: もう報告書を送りました。
en: I've already sent the report.
alternatives: I've sent the report already.
I already sent the report.
point: 「もう」は already。have + 過去分詞 sent

ja: 未定ですが、少し遅れそうです。
en: It looks like we might slip a little.
alternatives: We may be running a little behind.
It seems we could fall slightly behind.
point: might と a little で断定を避ける

ja: 人手があれば、間に合うのに。
en: If we had help, we'd make it.
alternatives: If we had another person, we could make it.
We'd make it if we had more help.
point: 今の仮定は if + 過去形、would + 原形

ja: 私には紙が必要。
en: I need paper.
alternatives: I need some paper.
Some paper would help.
point: paper は紙の素材として数えないので an を付けない。

ja: 何が問題ですか？
en: What's the problem?
alternatives: What's the issue?
What's wrong?
point: 「何が」は What。特定の問題なので the

ja: 承認に遅れがあります。
en: There's a delay in approval.
alternatives: Approval is running late.
Approval is taking longer than expected.
point: a delay in でどこに遅れがあるか示す。

ja: 金曜までに終えられません。
en: I can't finish it by Friday.
alternatives: I can't get it done by Friday.
I'm unable to finish by Friday.
point: できないは can't、期限は by

ja: 納期がいつかご存じですか？
en: Do you know when it's due?
alternatives: Do you know when the deadline is?
Would you know when it's due?
point: 間接疑問は when it's due の語順

ja: わかり次第、ご報告します。
en: I'll update you when I know.
alternatives: I'll update you once I know.
I'll tell you once I know.
point: when 節の中は未来でも現在形

ja: 法務は来週連絡すると言ってた。
en: Legal said they'd circle back next week.
alternatives: Legal said they'd get back to us next week.
Legal said they'd follow up next week.
point: said の後は will が would に変わる

ja: 原因が分かったので直します。
en: Knowing the cause, I'll fix it.
alternatives: Now I've found the cause, I'll fix it.
I found the cause, so I'll fix it.
point: 理由は Knowing で先に言う分詞構文

ja: 遅延で我々は現状維持だけでも必死だ。
en: Delays have us running to stand still.
alternatives: Delays leave us barely holding our ground.
With delays, we're barely treading water.
point: run to stand still は努力しても現状維持が精いっぱい。

ja: 進み具合を知らせてね。
en: Keep me posted.
alternatives: Keep me updated.
Let me know how it's going.
Update me on your progress.
point: Keep me posted は「随時知らせて」の定番

ja: 承認後に私が手配するよ。
en: I'll arrange it once approval arrives.
alternatives: I'll arrange it when approval comes through.
I'll make arrangements once we get approval.
point: once は承認が下り次第という条件を表す。

ja: 足を引っ張っているのは、引き継ぎです。
en: What's holding us back is the handoff.
alternatives: It's the handoff that's holding us back.
The handoff is what's holding us back.
point: 足を引っ張る = hold back。What 節で焦点を後ろへ置く

ja: 万事予定どおりです。
en: Everything is on schedule.
alternatives: Everything is going as planned.
Everything is on track.
point: Everything は単数扱いなので is

ja: 私は目標を達成しました。
en: I met the target.
alternatives: I achieved my goal.
I reached my goal.
point: meet a target は目標を達成する。

ja: 報告は金曜でもいいですか？
en: Could I report back on Friday?
alternatives: Is it okay if I update you on Friday?
Is Friday okay for the report?
point: 許可を求めるときは Could I 〜？ が使える

ja: 明日、ご報告します。
en: I'll update you tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll report back tomorrow.
I'm going to update you tomorrow.
point: update + 人。「報告する」は update you が自然

ja: 売上は先月より好調です。
en: Sales are better than last month.
alternatives: Sales are up from last month.
Sales are stronger than last month.
point: 比べる相手は than で示す

ja: 私たちは問題を取り繕ってるかも。
en: We may be papering over the cracks.
alternatives: We might be glossing over the problems.
Perhaps we're covering up the underlying problems.
point: paper over the cracks は根本を直さず取り繕う。

ja: 予算がきついです。
en: The budget is tight.
alternatives: The budget is limited.
We're on a tight budget.
point: 「きつい」は tight。予算は the budget

ja: もっと早く報告すべきでした。
en: I should have reported it sooner.
alternatives: I should have told you earlier.
I ought to have reported it earlier.
point: 後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 我々は甘い試算だと知った。
en: We found the estimate was too optimistic.
alternatives: We discovered the estimate was too optimistic.
We learned our estimate was too optimistic.
point: too optimistic は見積もりが楽観的すぎて甘いこと。

ja: 報告書を書き終えました。
en: I finished writing the report.
alternatives: I've finished writing the report.
I'm done writing the report.
point: finish の後ろは ~ing

ja: もっと早くお伝えすればよかった。
en: I wish I'd told you sooner.
alternatives: I wish I had told you earlier.
I wish I'd let you know sooner.
I should have told you sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: 先方に承認してもらった。
en: I got the client to sign off.
alternatives: I had the client sign off on it.
I got the client to approve it.
point: get + 人 + to 原形。sign off は承認する

ja: それでも我々の試算は精査に耐えない。
en: Even so, our estimates don't bear scrutiny.
alternatives: Nevertheless, our estimates don't stand up to scrutiny.
Still, our estimates don't withstand close examination.
point: bear scrutiny は厳しく調べても成り立つこと。

ja: 作業は順調に進んでいます。
en: Things are coming along nicely.
alternatives: It's coming along well.
We're making good progress.
point: 順調に進むは come along

ja: 先日話した問題は解決済みです。
en: The issue I raised is resolved.
alternatives: The problem I mentioned has been solved.
The issue that I brought up is resolved.
point: 目的語の関係詞 that は省ける

ja: 心配なのは日程です。
en: What worries me is the schedule.
alternatives: What I'm worried about is the schedule.
The schedule is what worries me.
point: What worries me is ~ の形で「〜なのは〜だ」

ja: 私が知らせていれば、今は無事なのに。
en: If I'd raised it, we'd be fine now.
alternatives: If I'd flagged it, we'd be fine now.
If I'd spoken up, we'd be fine now.
Had I raised it, we'd be fine now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は had done / would be

ja: 私たちは金曜にやっと気づいた。
en: Not until Friday did we notice it.
alternatives: Only on Friday did we notice it.
It wasn't until Friday that we noticed it.
We didn't notice it until Friday.
point: Not until を前に出すと、did we と倒置する

ja: この数字を見て。
en: Look at this number.
alternatives: Check this number.
Look at the number here.
point: look at で報告中のこの数字を見るよう促す。

ja: 私たちは損失を抑えたいです。
en: We aim to contain the losses.
alternatives: Our goal is to limit the losses.
We want to keep the losses down.
point: contain は損失が広がるのを抑える。

ja: その件は、ずっと調べています。
en: I've been looking into it.
alternatives: I've been digging into it.
I've been investigating it.
point: 調べるは look into、継続は現在完了進行形

ja: すぐ上司に相談したほうがいい。
en: You should consult your boss now.
alternatives: You'd better talk to your boss soon.
You should talk to your boss right away.
point: 助言は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 遅れても、品質は落としません。
en: Even if we slip, quality won't suffer.
alternatives: Even if we're late, quality won't suffer.
Even if we fall behind, we won't cut quality.
point: Even if は「たとえ〜でも」

ja: 知ってれば我々は警鐘を鳴らしたのに。
en: Had we known, we'd have sounded the alarm.
alternatives: If we'd known, we'd have sounded the alarm.
Had we known, we'd have raised the alarm.
point: If を省くと Had we known と倒置。警鐘は sound the alarm
